reason: B is more physically plausible: suppressing selective oxidation in a genuinely reducing atmosphere should generally preserve the alloy better than air exposure, whereas A does not justify why failure to form an oxide would itself accelerate degradation. B also provides a clearer, falsifiable link among atmosphere, Cr/Ti depletion, scale spallation, and mechanical loss, although the assumed spallation at 100 hours and the role of Al still require experimental verification.
